title: Protocol for the isolation and purification of human follicular dendritic cells for functional assays
protocol: Discard the liquid from beaker containing the tonsils.
Add ice cold PBS to the beaker and remove any blood clots from the outside of the tonsils using tweezers and scissors.
Pour ice cold PBS (20–30 mL) in a Petri dish or equivalent container.
Place the metal sieve on top of the petri dish and transfer the tonsils to the sieve.
Cut the tonsils into 1-2 mm slices using tweezers and scissors.
Cut tonsils into smaller pieces with scissors on top of the sieve.
Use glass plunger to push tissue fragments through the metal mesh.
Collect lymphocytes and smaller tissue fragments in PBS.
Discard white connective tissue and blood clots remaining after pushing brown tissue through the metal sieve.
Underlay cell suspension with 21% and 34% Percoll.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 25 min to separate stromal cells.
Use a flattened glass rod to push tissue through the metal sieve, ensuring light brown tissue passes through.
Wash any remaining tissue stuck to the underside of the sieve with cell suspension using a 10 mL serological pipet.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Add fresh PBS to acquire all tiny fragments if necessary.
Spin the suspension at 200 g for 10 seconds to pellet tissue fragments.
Remove the supernatant containing free-floating lymphocytes.
Optional: Underlay lymphocytes with 21% and 80% Percoll™.
Add 3 mL digestion mix gently by pipetting.
Incubate the mixture for 15 minutes at 37°C.
Transfer the supernatant (2-3 mL) to a 50 mL Falcon tube containing HBSS without calcium/magnesium, HEPES, FCS, EDTA, and gentamycin on ice.
Repeat steps 12 and 13 three times until tonsil is fully digested, up to one hour.
Be gentle while mixing tissue fragments with the digestion mix.
Filter the cell suspension through a final metal sieve.
Spin down the filtered cells at 200 g at 4°C for 6 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 25 mL PBS.
Filter the resuspended cells through a cell strainer with a 70 μM mesh.
Underlay 10–15 mL of 21% Percoll™ using gravity mode on a pipetboy.
Underlay 10–15 mL of 34% Percoll™ using gravity mode on a pipetboy.
Optional: Underlay an additional 80% Percoll™ layer to isolate lymphocytes.
Spin the sample without breaks in a swinging bucket centrifuge at 300 g for 25 minutes at room temperature.
Collect the stromal cells at the interface between 21% and 34% Percoll™ using a Pasteur pipette.
Transfer the collected stromal cells to a 50 mL falcon tube with 20 mL HBSS w/o calcium/magnesium + 20 mM HEPES + 2 mM EDTA + 5% FCS + gentamycin.
Spin down the transferred cells at 200 g for 7 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant to remove any residual Percoll™.
Resuspend the pellet in 5 mL FDC medium.
Count the cells.
Transfer cells to a Round-Bottom Polystyrene Tube (FACS tube).
Adjust the total cell amount to a maximum of 1 × 10^8 cells.
Wash the cells with sort buffer.
Spin down at 200 g for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend the cell suspension in 100 μL sort buffer.
Add 1 μL biotinylated CD35 antibody per 1 × 10^7 cells.
Incubate on ice for 15 minutes.
Wash the cells with 2.5 mL sort buffer.
Spin down at 200 g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL sort buffer.
Vortex resuspend streptavidin nanobeads at maximum speed with five touches.
Add 10 μL of streptavidin nanobeads per 1 × 10^7 cells or adjust volume so that the nanobeads do not exceed 20% of total volume if fewer than 1 × 10^7 cells are used.
Wash the cells with 2.5 mL sort buffer.
Spin down at 200 g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cells in 2.5 mL sort buffer and place in MojoSort magnet for 5 minutes.
Pour off unlabeled cells, which can be stored to check efficiency of enrichment.
Resuspend labeled (selected) cells in 2.5 mL sort buffer.
Place resuspended cells in MojoSort magnet for 5 minutes.
Repeat steps involving washing, centrifuging, and magnetic separation two more times for a total of three separations.
Resuspend the cells in FDC medium to desired concentration.
Plate the cells in collagen and laminin coated wells.
Incubate at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Properly resuspend and vortex streptavidin nanobeads before use.
Wash the cells with 2.5 mL sort buffer.
Spin down the cells at 200 g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cells in 100 μL sort buffer.
Add FDC antibody cocktail to the resuspended cells and incubate on ice for 30 minutes in the dark.
Wash the cells with 2.5 mL sort buffer.
Spin down the cells at 200 g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cells in sort buffer to a concentration of 3 × 10^7 cells per mL.
Add 2.5 μL helix-NP per 1 mL of cell suspension just before starting the sort.
Sort the cells using a 100 μm nozzle on the Sony MA900 cell sorter.
Collect the FDCs in a tube with 1 mL FDC medium at 4°C.
Spin down the cells at 200 g for 5 min.
Resuspend the cells in FDC medium to the desired concentration.
Plate the cells in collagen and laminin coated wells.
Incubate the plated cells at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
